cadence.issue_derivation: a failing nwi-s0-exit-gate receipt, once appended, derives exactly one NATIVE SV_ISSUE (derive_issue_from_check_receipt; ONE_RECEIPT_DERIVES_ONE_ISSUE); the same subject has the same digest, so it is not evaluated twice; a new commit, manifest blob or base is a new evaluation
cadence.receipts_per_evaluation: one receipt per evidence producer and one nwi-s0-exit-gate receipt, all with change_digest = the subject digest and head_sha = evaluated_commit
cadence.trigger: a stage-gate evaluation from NWI-S0 to NWI-S1 (stage_gate.evaluate_gate) requested for one evaluation subject; never a push, a pull-request head or a schedule

evaluation_subject.carried_by: the STAGE_GATE outcome (stage_gate.evaluate_gate(..., subject=...): evaluation_subject and evaluation_subject_digest) and its organization transition request; the receipt carries only change_digest and head_sha
evaluation_subject.digest: sha256:<hex sha256(canon(subject))> over exactly these five fields

fields.base_ref: {registry_generation read at evaluated_commit, ledger_head = the observed head of the repository's own refs/stegverse/organization-ledger}
fields.evaluated_commit: the 40-hex commit of the repository the stage is evaluated at (the receipts' head_sha); it identifies the subject only and never supplies the gate manifest
fields.manifest_blob: the git blob the gate declaration's data/sv-work-items/contract-pins.json pins for data/sv-work-items/stages/NWI-S0.json (manifest_source CONTRACT_PINS; GATE_MANIFEST_IS_THE_CONTRACT_PINNED_MANIFEST); never the blob at evaluated_commit, which only identifies the subject. A subject whose manifest was read from itself is DENY GATE_MANIFEST_READ_FROM_SUBJECT
fields.repository: the repository the stage is evaluated in, e.g. StegVerse-Labs/.github

evaluation_subject.pairing: a gate-derived issue is sourced by the base-side failing receipt (evaluated_commit = the change's base commit) and resolved by the head-side ALLOW receipt (evaluated_commit = the change's head commit); same repository, exactly the same contract-pinned manifest_blob, both ledgered at the change's base ledger_head (sv_work_items.verify_resolution_pair)

evidence_producers.covers: scripts/build_sv_native_fixtures.py --check re-derives data/sv-work-items/migration/sv-issues.jsonl and sv-changes.jsonl and validates every record against schemas/sv-issue.v1.schema.json and schemas/sv-change.v1.schema.json with resident-runtime/schema_subset.py (FAIL_CLOSED SV_WORK_ITEM_SCHEMA_INVALID, exit 1, on any error), then checks the committed files are byte-identical

tests.test_sv_native_work_items.MigrationFixtureTests loads every record of data/sv-work-items/migration/sv-issues.jsonl and sv-changes.jsonl and passes each through validate_issue / validate_change (and their schemas); tests.test_sv_record_modes checks each fixture's record mode and unknown_fields

hb_epoch.source: the Labs#3266 base-state readback (stegverse.sv-change-base-state-readback/v1) of evaluation_subject.repository
hb_epoch.unobserved: no receipt is emitted (sv-check-receipt.v1 requires a well-formed hb_epoch and none is minted); the stage evaluation is FAIL_CLOSED STAGE_EVIDENCE_UNOBSERVED with no stage move

exit_gate_check.home: this stage manifest: the required-checks row SV-CHANGE-REQUIRED-CHECKS-001 declares the checks an SV_CHANGE needs per touched surface; a stage gate is required of no change, so its check is declared where the gate is (stage_gate.py reads gates only from these manifests)

offline_command.predicate: STAGE_GATE_PASSES over this manifest's exit_gate (stage_gate.evaluate_gate from NWI-S0 to NWI-S1): every exit predicate has a receipted ALLOW

receipt_form.appended_by: the org-ledger writer's sv_check_receipt operation (Labs#3255/#3270): the check receipt is the repo receipt's $.evidence
receipt_form.applies_to: the nwi-s0-exit-gate receipt and each evidence producer's receipt of the same evaluation
receipt_form.fields_beyond_schema: none: sv-check-receipt.v1 is closed (additionalProperties false) and validates unchanged
receipt_form.ledger_ref: refs/stegverse/organization-ledger@<ledger commit>:receipts/<org receipt sha256 hex>.json of the evaluation subject's own repository (CHANGE_BINDS_TARGET_REPOSITORY_LEDGER; StegVerse-Labs/.github for Labs)
receipt_form.manifest_binding: change_digest binds the subject, whose manifest_blob is the contract-pinned blob; validate_gate_receipt(..., contract_pins=) gives DENY GATE_MANIFEST_READ_FROM_SUBJECT otherwise
receipt_form.six_fields: on DENY and FAIL_CLOSED: failure_code, failed_predicate, required_evidence_or_repair, retry_entrypoint, owning_existing_goal, next_attempt

name: DEFINE
thresholds_source: this manifest only; a null value is undeclared and the gate FAIL_CLOSES STAGE_THRESHOLD_UNDECLARED
